Definition: neuter of G3441 as adverb; merely:--alone, but, only.
BiblicalUsage: Monon means only, merely, alone — whoever gives one of these little ones a cup of cold water only, in the name of a disciple, shall not lose his reward, and to the Philippians it is given not only to believe on Christ but also to suffer for His sake.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the small word guards the big promises: a cup of water counts, and suffering counts, and neither is lost.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
